name: Govern
description: Cross-cutting organizational policies, accountability structures, culture, and processes that make risk management repeatable across the organization.

name: Map
description: Establishing context, categorizing the AI system, and identifying risks and impacts before they can be measured or managed.

name: Measure
description: Analyzing, assessing, benchmarking, and monitoring AI risks and trustworthy characteristics using quantitative, qualitative, and mixed methods.

name: Manage
description: Prioritizing, responding to, and treating identified AI risks, including third-party risk, incident response, and recovery.
